findings.issue: אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה licenses bringing them to the outside of the camp. “a fuera al campamento” marks the camp as the place they are taken to.
Hophal 3ms agrees with masculine דָּם. Feminine “traída” only matches Spanish sangre; the patient is still the blood.

notes: Toro, macho cabrío, pecado twice, blood brought, piel expiar, hiphil sacará, and plural quemarán of skins, flesh, and dung match the tokens.
